about_the_game:
Next-Gen Tactical FPS | DNA-Enhanced Combat | Futuristic Multiplayer Warfare

Upgrade Your DNA. Join the Elite. Dominate the Future.

Step into the warzone of tomorrow in Elite Forces, a real-time multiplayer First-Person Shooter where futuristic warfare meets high-octane strategy. Powered by AAA next-generation visuals, Elite Forces plunges you into the heart of sci-fi battlegrounds with cutting-edge design, competitive DNA upgrades, and a hyper-polished combat experience.

Core Features:

DNA Module System
Before each match, choose your genetic edge:

  • Max Speed – Blitz across the battlefield at lightning pace

  • Max Health – Absorb more damage and become a tank of survival

  • Max Jump Force – Gain vertical dominance and reach tactical high ground

4 Futuristic Sci-Fi Environments
Battle across diverse, visually striking maps—each with their own unique layout, terrain advantages, and immersive ambiance.

Real-Time Online Multiplayer
Play with friends or team up with random players across the globe in intense online showdowns.

AAA Visuals & Immersive UX
Experience a visually flawless sci-fi battlefield built with next-gen graphics and a sleek, futuristic user experience that puts control, clarity, and competition at your fingertips.

Teamplay and Competition
Join forces with allies or challenge your rivals in tightly balanced tactical firefights. Your skill—and your DNA—define your legacy.

Whether you're a lone wolf or a squad commander, Elite Forces is your new arena of evolution. Adapt fast, shoot sharp, and rise as one of the elites.

name: Elite Forces

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.3 Ghz to 3.69 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA Virtual Audio Device (Wave Extensible) (WDM)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Elite Forces is a real-time multiplayer FPS with next-gen sci-fi visuals. Choose your DNA module—Max Speed, Health, or Jump—and battle across 4 futuristic maps. Play with friends or team up with random players in fast, tactical combat.
